test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 5: Participating in a Live Class
test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher Logs In to Start a Live Class Session
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher with a pre-provisioned account ('GiangGiangteacher@gmail.com') exists in the system. The 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course has been created (TC-002), updated (TC-003), has a scheduled session (TC-004), and additional reference documents uploaded (TC-005). The teacher had previously logged out (TC-019).
test_cases.expected_result: The teacher is successfully authenticated, their session is initiated, and they are redirected to the Dashboard Page, where they can see their courses and initiate the live video session.
test_cases.post_condition: The teacher is logged in and on the Dashboard Page, ready to navigate to the 'Sessions' tab of the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course.
